items.html: Hence, it is necessarily true that as long as Malchut has not yet grown, those upper ten Sefirot that are lacking from the Nukva must be included in ZA, in his ten Sefirot, as is known — that he has only until the Yesod, and the Nukva completes him to ten. And then they are nineteen Sefirot: his nine and her ten; and she is called the tenth, since she is the tenth to him; and he is completed in ten Sefirot together with her, and she too has ten Sefirot.
